name: free_play
description: Start where the game normally does, but never lose energy.
evidence: $2B88 is the damage routine: it plays a sound, decrements the energy count at $3B, and sets the death flag at $62 when that decrement reaches zero, then redraws the bar through $2630
replacing the decrement with LDA #$01 leaves the Z flag clear, so the BNE that guards the death store is always taken; $2630 begins TYA/PHA/LDA $3B and never reads A on entry, so clobbering A is safe
qualifications: two NOPs cannot be used in place of the decrement: NOP sets no flags, so the guarding BNE would read whatever the preceding subroutine return left behind and could set the death flag on the first contact
$2B88 still plays its damage sound and redraws the bar, so contact remains visible and audible; only the energy cost is removed

the vertical velocity step at $4D is deliberately left alone: gravity subtracts the same step at $277B that the jet boots add, so raising it for stronger flight makes the fall proportionally faster and the game unplayable
flying is gated per room by something not yet identified; the thrust code at $2689 and $2699 applies unconditionally, so the gate lies elsewhere
